template:
s1 = winsorize(ts_backfill({special_items_score}, 63), std=4)
s2 = winsorize(ts_backfill({accrued_expenses_score}, 63), std=4)
s3 = winsorize(ts_backfill({revenue_recognition_score}, 63), std=4)
s4 = winsorize(ts_backfill({deferred_rev_score}, 63), std=4)
curr = divide(add(add(add(s1, s2), s3), s4), 4)
long_term = ts_mean(curr, 252)
deviation = subtract(curr, long_term)
dev_weighted = signed_power(winsorize(deviation, std=3), 1.5)
below_hist = less(curr, long_term)
persistence = ts_mean(below_hist, 63)
signal = subtract(dev_weighted, multiply(3.0, persistence))
signal = group_zscore(signal, industry)
idea: 持续偏离惩罚模型：计算当前得分与长期均值的偏离，并使用幂变换放大极端偏离。同时计算过去63日中低于长期均值的频率（持续性指标），对长期处于低质量区间的股票施加额外惩罚，区分暂时性会计噪音与持续性盈余操纵行为。
